N064_check_01 — Root GPT-6 Astra Pro/current run actually checked the first lifting correspondence in (5). For the source's fiber product P = E_{U_S} ×_{E_S} E_K, write p:E_{U_S}→E_S and q:E_K→E_S for the displayed downward and leftward arrows. With projections pr1, pr2, a section s of pr2 maps to f=pr1∘s; the inverse sends f to the map g↦(f(g),g). Root verified p∘f=q, both composites equal to the respective identity, and preservation of componentwise multiplication and continuity. This check covers the first lifting correspondence only; the later kernel-descent sentence and the source conjectures were not checked.
